messages:
harper-docs: FYI from onboarding review: the quickstart's "retry" example shows a simple while-loop that re-posts the same body on 5xx. Several customers copied this into production and accidentally created duplicate resources because there was no idempotency header. We had a support ticket where a billing table got two rows because of that loop.

julian-sdk: That's a bad one. We used that naive loop originally for brevity, but we should never show retry logic without an idempotency key or SDK helper. Suggest we change the example to use `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` and show the SDK helper `client.generate({..., idempotencyKey: uuid()})` so copy/paste is safe.

rina-support: Confirmed. Two tickets this week referencing "duplicate object created" after following README retry pattern. Customers expect docs copy/paste to be safe. Can we also add a short note about what endpoints are idempotent vs not? The docs currently don't clarify.

chris-qa: Proposed changes: 1) Replace naive loop with a retry snippet that attaches a generated idempotency UUID and uses exponential backoff (capped). 2) Add an inline badge in the reference table marking which endpoints require idempotency keys for retries. 3) Add a docs smoke test that executes the retry snippet against a mocked server and asserts the mocked server received the request at most once when the mock replies with a transient 502 then a success.

julian-sdk: I'll open the PR to update codeblocks and add SDK helper examples for Node/Python/Go. Also adding a utility `docs-utils/generate-idempotency.js` so examples use the same helper.

ops-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1799 assigned to @julian-sdk.

harper-docs: One more subtlety: the curl quickstart currently uses `-H 'X-Api-Key: $TOKEN'` in some languages and `Authorization: Bearer` in others. While we're editing the retry example, let's canonicalize to `Authorization: Bearer`. Also add a PowerShell variant because single quotes break there.

julian-sdk: Agreed. For the new retry snippet I propose these examples:

Minimal (safe) curl example:
```bash
ID=$(uuidgen)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/create 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" 
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $ID" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"name":"example"}'
```

Node (uses SDK helper):
```js
import { v4 as uuid } from 'uuid';
const id = uuid();
const res = await client.create({ name: 'example', idempotencyKey: id });
```

Python (requests):
```py
import uuid
id = str(uuid.uuid4())
resp = requests.post(url, headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")}', 'Idempotency-Key': id}, json={'name':'example'})
```

chris-qa: I'll add the mocked server test in the PR and a CI job that runs the docs smoke test. The test will assert the server saw one POST when simulating a transient error sequence.

rina-support: Please also add a short troubleshooting FAQ: "Why did my POST create duplicates?" with steps to add idempotency keys and how to reconcile duplicates. That'll reduce support churn.

julian-sdk: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/623 (replace retry loop with idempotency examples, add endpoint idempotency table, add smoke test and PowerShell note). I'll include a changelog entry under docs: "fix(docs): safe retry examples with idempotency; canonicalize auth header".

harper-docs: Excellent. After merge, let's backport to stable and post a quick note in #onboarding and #support. Also add a docs-lint rule to flag naive retry loops (regex matching common loop patterns) so they don't return.

ops-bot: Linked PR to issue #1799 and scheduled a docs deploy run after CI passes.

chris-qa: QA checklist added in the PR: run snippet, verify idempotency header present, verify PowerShell example uses double quotes for header value.

rina-support: Thanks team  this should prevent more accidental duplicates and save support time.

harper-docs: :thumbsup:
